# plot_correlation_heatmap { #autoeda.plot.plot_correlation_heatmap }

```python
plot.plot_correlation_heatmap(
    df,
    target=None,
    method='pearson',
    figsize=(10, 8),
)
```

Generate a correlation heatmap for numeric features in a dataset.

This function computes pairwise correlations between numeric columns
and visualizes them as a heatmap. Optionally, a target column can be
highlighted to show correlations specifically with the target.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type                         | Description                                                                                                     | Default     |
|---------|------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| df      | pandas.DataFrame             | Input dataframe containing numeric and non-numeric features.                                                    | _required_  |
| target  | str                          | Name of the target column. If provided, correlations with the target may be emphasized or displayed separately. | `None`      |
| method  | (pearson, spearman, kendall) | Correlation method to use.                                                                                      | `"pearson"` |
| figsize | tuple                        | Size of the heatmap figure.                                                                                     | `(10, 8)`   |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                 | Description                                           |
|--------|----------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|
|        | matplotlib.axes.Axes | The Axes object containing the heatmap visualization. |
